name: Wiktor
self_text: I am a Spanish man in my early 30s who spends my free time collecting vinyl. I shoot with Sony gear and enjoy the creative process of capturing the world. A typical outing for me is a relaxed photo walk at a moderate pace. I always enjoy having plenty of gear talk during the session. Regarding the technical side, there will be no post-processing lesson this time. I am available to head out on Saturday morning, Saturday afternoon, or during weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available on Saturday afternoon, Saturday morning, or weekday evenings, and you have to be into a relaxed photo walk. It would be nice if you are okay with plenty of gear talk or if gear talk is fine but not the point. Ideally, you are okay with a fast pace or a moderate pace, but no big deal.
